decision: Selected the centroid of ALKIS parcel Trebbin Flur 2 Flurstück 1117 (the parcel the municipal heat-planning report names for the data centre) as the project locator; the two building footprints within it are not separately located.
identity_bridge: Stadt Trebbin heat-planning final report (EWE NETZ for the city): the data centre is to be built on Flurstück 1117 of Flur 2 in Gemarkung Trebbin; two data-centre buildings per the building-application documents provided by the city; developer calculations about 180 MW total electrical load.

Stadt Trebbin article (7 October 2026, updated 12 October 2026): planned data centre at the town entrance in the area of the Porta furniture warehouse; binding B-Plan; permits issued for two larger buildings and a substation.

Report Figure 32 shows the two data-centre footprints north-east of the Porta logistics centre beside the B101; ALKIS large storage and forwarding buildings (An der B101 2) lie about 460 m south-west of the parcel centroid, consistent with the figure.
